build.notes: Build directory fully removed and reconfigured from scratch between first and second build. ELF/BIN/UF2 hashes matched exactly. Initial submission passed CMake options directly (-DPICO_NO_BI_PROGRAM_BUILD_DATE=1), which Sol's verification found ineffective: this is a C preprocessor macro guard (#if !PICO_NO_BI_PROGRAM_BUILD_DATE), not a CMake command-line variable, so it was silently ignored (warning only) and __DATE__ remained embedded in the binary. The two same-day builds happened to match only because __DATE__ was identical within the same day; a build on a different date would have broken reproducibility. Corrected by passing the macro via CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS environment variables at configure time (CMake concatenates these into the toolchain init flags safely, unlike overriding CMAKE_C_FLAGS directly, which strips the SDK's architecture flags and breaks the build). Re-verified with two clean builds: identical SHA-256 and zero date-string occurrences via `strings | grep` for a date pattern.
